_doc: Per-block cases for install.test.mjs. Keys are block directory names under blocks/ (or an entry with its own "path", relative to the repo root). A block with no entry still runs once with default params. The default case is always run; "cases" adds param sets. registryDependencies are installed first (resolved by directory name under blocks/), with default params unless a case sets "dependencyParams": {"crypto-utils": {"k": "v"}}. "chains" install several blocks in sequence into one project: steps are {block, params?}. Every installed block is then verified.
